name: help_show
description: Show the welcome card again, from its first page: how to talk to Albie (face him and talk, or hold a palm up and he hops on), three things to try (make a slalom, show a beating heart, drive the truck twice so Albie learns it) and, once a truck is out, how to drive it. Its next pages show the four sample projects (worked examples to explore or copy), how a project works (design, test in the room, drive or fly, train, share) and how to start your own (Build something, or 'Albie, build me a ...'). Call it when the person asks for help, what they can do here, or how this works. Then tell them one or two of the ideas in your own words.
